n-k-k6-02.title: Garee kamtu seenuu danda'a?
n-k-k6-02.topic: Seera daangaa qabu dubbisuu: garee, qixxeessa, fi baajata
n-k-k6-02.goal: Beeksisa seenuu seerri isaa wal daangessu dubbisi, garee hedduu seerota hundumaa tokko tokkoon guutan ijaari, fi gareen gosa tokko maaliif gonkumaa hojjechuu akka hin dandeenye ibsi.
n-k-k6-02.material:
Garee kee mana kuusaa saayinsii daa'immanii daawwachuu barbaada. Beeksisa dubbisa fi baajata murteessita.

[어린이 과학관 단체 입장 안내]
- 요금: 어른 한 명 5,000원, 어린이 한 명 3,000원
- 어린이는 어른과 함께 와야 합니다. 어른 한 명당 어린이 세 명까지 들어갈 수 있습니다.
- 단체 입장은 모두 5명 이상일 때만 가능합니다.
- 어린이가 1명 이상 있는 단체만 신청할 수 있습니다.

Baajata garee kee: 총 요금 25,000원 이하.
n-k-k6-02.thinking.0: Jechoota hanga Koriyaa gara haala tti jijjiiruu
n-k-k6-02.thinking.2: Seerri tokko seera biraa akkamitti daangessu hubachuu
n-k-k6-02.prereq.0: 이상 / 이하 fi 최대 ni beeka
n-k-k6-02.prereq.1: Gatii 원 tiin herreguu ni danda'a
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.prompt: Seera maanguddoo fi daa'ima qofa ilaali (gatii fi seera guddina garee dhiisi). Daawwannaan kamtu hin hayyamamu?
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.hint.0: '어른 한 명당 어린이 세 명까지' akka seera maanguddaa tokko tokkoo adda irratti hojjetu dubbisi.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.hint.1: Filannoo tokko tokkoof, baay'ina maanguddaa daa'imman hayyamaman waliin baay'isi fi wal-bira qabi.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.r.b: Hayyamameera: maanguddaan tokko daa'imman hanga sadii fidu danda'a, fi sadi daangaa mataa isaati.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.r.c: Hayyamameera: maanguddoonni lama daa'imman hanga ja'a fiduu danda'u.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.r.d: Hayyamameera: maanguddoonni afur daa'imman hanga kudha lama fiduu danda'u.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.explain: Daangaan daa'imman sadi maanguddaa TOKKO TOKKOOF dha. Maanguddoonni lama daa'imman baay'inaan 2 x 3 = 6 fiduu danda'u, kanaaf torba baay'ee dha.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.prompt: Garee adda addaa 3 seera HUNDUMAA fi baajata guutan ijaari. a = baay'ina maanguddaa, c = baay'ina daa'imman.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.hint.0: Dura haalawwan afran jechoota mataa keetiin barreessi (maanguddaa, daa'imman maanguddaa tokkoof, waliigala namoota, maallaqa).
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.hint.1: Dura baay'ina maanguddaa filadhu, ergasii baay'ina daa'imman seera qixxeessaa fi seera namoota 5 irraa hayyamame argi.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.hint.2: Maallaqa dhumarratti mirkaneessi: 5,000 x maanguddaa + 3,000 x daa'imman.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c0: Lakkoofsa namoota guutuu fayyadami (daa'imman 0 ykn isaa ol).
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c1: 어린이는 어른과 함께 와야 합니다: xiqqaan maanguddaa tokko.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Maanguddaa tokkoof daa'imman sadi caalu hin danda'amu.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Daa'imman baay'ee: maanguddaa tokkoof baay'inaan sadi.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c3: 단체 입장은 5명 이상: waliigalatti xiqqaan namoota 5.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c5: 어린이가 1명 이상 있는 단체만 신청할 수 있습니다: xiqqaan daa'ima tokko.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.explain: Fakkeenyaaf maanguddoonni 2 + daa'imman 3 = won 19,000; 3 + 2 = won 21,000; 4 + 1 = won 23,000. Garee jaha hundi isaan simata: (2,3), (2,4), (2,5), (3,2), (3,3), (4,1). Beeksisni daangaa kenna, garee sirrii tokko miti.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Garee maanguddaa TOKKO qofa qabu yaali. Hima tokko ykn lama (Afaan Ingilizii ykn Koriyaa) maaliif garee akkasii seera guutuu hin dandeenye ibsi. Lakkoofsa fayyadami.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Garee maanguddaa tokko qabu namoota baay'inaan meeqa qabaachuu danda'a lakkaa'i.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Lakkoofsa sana seera guddina garee waliin wal-bira qabi.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Daangaa daa'imman 3 fi xiqqaan namoota 5 waliin fayyadameeraa?
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Lakkoofsonni koo maanguddoota 2 tiif illee hojjetaa?
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Maanguddaa 1 waliin, daa'imman baay'inaan 3 dhufuu danda'u, kanaaf gareen namoota 4 qofa dha, garuu xiqqaan 5 dha.

n-k-k6-05.s.s1.prompt: Kutaa tokkoon tokkoon dubbisi, hiika carraa guddaa qabu filadhu, achiis itti fufi.
n-k-k6-05.title: Hojii manaa hojjete?
n-k-k6-05.topic: Wal-dhaga'uu dhabuu ergaa keessatti: 다 + 안 'tokkollee' ykn 'hundaa miti' jechuu danda'a
n-k-k6-05.goal: Wal-jijjiirraa gabaabaa tarkaanfiidhaan dubbisi, 'ㅡ 다 안 했어요' hiika lama qabaachuu danda'u argi, odeeffannoon yommuu dhufu dubbisa sirreessi, fi himoota wal-dhaga'uu dhabuu hin qabne barreessi.
n-k-k6-05.material: Barsiisaan waa'ee hojii manaa gaafata. Hojiin manaa rakkoo 10 qaba ture.
n-k-k6-05.thinking.1: Odeeffannoon haaraan yommuu dhufu dubbisa sirreessuu
n-k-k6-05.thinking.2: Ergaa akka hin dogoggoramne deebisee barreessuu
n-k-k6-05.prereq.0: 안 + xumura fi 못 + xumura beeka
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.hint.0: Wanta hanga ammaatti dubbiste qofa fayyadamuun murteessi, hiika himichi qabaachuu danda'u hunda ol-dhageessisi.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.hint.1: Sararoonni haaraan yommuu dabalaman hiikni kam ammallee simata gaafadhu.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Dubbisni lamaan danda'amoo dha: '다 안 했어요' 'tokkollee hin hojjenne' ykn 'hundaa hin hojjenne' jechuu danda'a. '죄송해요' wanti hanqate akka jiru agarsiisa, garuu hangam akka hin agarsiisu.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Tokko tokko hojjete, garuu hin xumurre.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Dhiifama gaafata ('죄송해요'), kunis hunda xumuruu wajjin hin simatu.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Sararoota keessa kutaa biraa waa'ee kan dubbatu hin jiru.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Amma '숙제를 다 안 했어요' maal jechuu ture?
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Odeeffannoon ni murteessa: rakkoo 10 keessaa 8 hojjetame, kanaaf himichi 'hundaa miti' jechuu ture.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Baayyee hojjete, rakkoo dhumaa lamaan dhiise.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Deebiin isaa lammaffaa rakkoo kam akka hojjete sirriitti hima.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: 유나 himicha kam barreessuu qabdi akka barsiisaan 'baayyee hojjete' jedhee hin dogoggorreef?
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.after: '하나도 안 했어요' 'kutaa' tiif bakka hin dhiisu. '다는 못 했어요' 'hundaa miti' jechuuf karaa ifaa dha.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kun himicha lamaan duraa wal fakkaatu; 'kutaa hojjete' hin cufu.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kun 'kutaa hojjete garuu hundaa miti' fakkaata, wanta 유나 jechuu barbaaduuf faallaa.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Kun hanga hundaa ta'e hojjete jedha.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.reflect: Jechoonni wal fakkaatoo turan, odeeffannoon qofa dubbisa kee jijjiire hubadhu. Dubbataan akka hubatamuuf mirkaneeffachuu barbaadu jechoota hiika tokko qofa kennan filachuu qaba.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.prompt: Himoota kana keessaa kam akkuma '숙제를 다 안 했어요' wal-dhaga'uu dhabuu danda'a?
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.hint.0: Himicha jecha 'hundaa' jechuu fi jecha ukkaamsaa wal arganitti argi.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.hint.1: Himicha hundaa haala lama garaagaraa yaadaa dubbadhu, kam lamaan hundaaf simata ilaali.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.b: Kun keessummoonni ammallee hin dhufne jedha; 'hundaa moo tokkollee' addaan hin qoodu.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.c: Kun ifatti tokkollee hin dhufne jedha.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.d: Kun xiqqoon dhufan jedha; 'tokkollee ykn hundaa miti' banaa hin dhiisu.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.explain: '다' (hundaa) ukkaamsaan duubaan 'tokkollee' ykn 'hundaa miti' jedhamee dubbifamuu danda'a, kanaaf '손님이 다 안 왔어요' dubbisa lama wal fakkaatu qaba.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.prompt: Himoota Afaan Koreaa (dubbii ulfaataa) lama barreessi, tokkoon tokkoon isaa hojii GARAAGARA irratti (fakkeenyaaf hojii manaa, qulqulleessuu ykn kitaaba). Himicha 1: hojii jalqabaa tokkollee hin hojjenne. Himicha 2: hojii lammaffaa kutaa qofa hojjete. Himicha lamaan keessatti '다 안' ykn '다 못' hin fayyadamin.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.hint.1: 'Kutaa' jechuuf, hangam akka hojjette himi (walakkaa, xiqqoo, hanga tokkotti) ykn gosa 'hundaa miti' jedhu fayyadami.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Himni koo tokkoon tokkoon isaa karaa tokkoon qofa dubbifamuu danda'aa?
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Himoonni lamaan dhugumatti hanga garaagara ibsuu?

n-k-k6-04.thinking.0: Cuunfaa madda wajjin wal bira qabuu
n-k-k6-04.title: Cuunfaan gabaasa wajjin simataa?
n-k-k6-04.topic: Gabaasa qorannoo amanamummaan cuunfachuu: gabaasni wanta deeggaru
n-k-k6-04.goal: Cuunfaa blogii hiriyaa kutaa fi gabaasa gaazexaa mana barumsaa wal bira qabi, sararoota gabaasni hin deeggarre argi, tokko sirreessi.
n-k-k6-04.material:
Gaazexaan mana barumsaa gabaasa gabaabaa maxxanse. 하준 hiriyaa gaazexaa dubbisuu hin dandeenye tiif blogii kutaa irratti cuunfe.

[학교 신문: 급식 설문 결과]
- 조사 대상: 6학년 2반 학생 24명 (6학년은 모두 다섯 반입니다.)
- 18명은 "급식이 맛있다", 6명은 "보통이다"라고 답했습니다. "맛없다"고 답한 학생은 없었습니다.
- 급식을 남기지 않는 학생은 14명이었습니다.
n-k-k6-04.thinking.2: Sarara ragaa isaa wajjin akka wal simu deebisee barreessuu
n-k-k6-04.prereq.0: Lakkoofsa 명 fi 반 wajjin beeka
n-k-k6-04.prereq.1: Gabaasa gabaabaa fi dubbii darbe (-대 / -래) dubbisuu danda'a
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.prompt: Cuunfaa 하준 gabaasa wajjin wal bira qabi. Sarara cuunfaa gabaasni hin deeggarre tokko filadhu. (Sararri tokko ol dogoggora.)
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.hint.0: Cuunfaa sarara sarara fudhadhu, himicha gabaasaa isa irraa dhufe argi.
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.hint.1: Sarara hundaaf, barattoota lakkoofsi gabaasaa waa'ee isaanii fi barattoota sarara sun waa'ee isaanii dubbatu wal bira qabi.
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.explain: Sararoonni 2, 4 fi 6 dogoggora. Gabaasni barattoota 24 qofa 6학년 2반 gaafate, kanaaf barattoota kutaa jaha hundaa, kutaawwan biroo, ykn mana barumsaa guutuu waa'ee hin dubbatu. Sararoonni 1, 3 fi 5 kutaa sanaa waa'ee dubbatu, gabaasa wajjin immoo simatu.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.prompt: Sararoonni dogoggoraa wanta tokko wal fakkaatu qabu. Dogoggora gosa kam?
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sarara filatte hundaaf, gabaasni barattoota kam waa'ee akka ta'e fi sararri barattoota kam waa'ee akka ta'e himi.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.hint.1: Gareewwan lamaan yommuu wal bira qabdu, sararoonni sadan maal wal fakkaatu qabu barbaadi.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.r.a: Lakkoofsonni 24 fi 14 cuunfaa keessa jiran gabaasa keessa kan jiran wajjin wal fakkaatu.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.o.b: Wanta beekame garee guddaa irratti jedhame.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.o.c: Xumuroonni ulfaataa gara xumuroota hiriyummaatti jijjiiraman.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.r.c: Xumuroonni hiriyummaa cuunfaa hiriyaatiif idilee dha, dogoggora ibsa waa'ee hin ta'u.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.o.d: Bu'aawwan qorannoo tokko tokko cuunfaa irraa hafan.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.r.d: Sararoonni dogoggoraa falmii dabalu; bu'aa hin hir'isan.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.explain: Gabaasni waa'ee barattoota 24 kutaa tokko keessa jiran dha. Sararoonni dogoggoraa bu'aa kana gara barattoota kutaa jaha hundaa, kutaawwan birootti, ykn mana barumsaa guutuutti dheeressu, gabaasni garuu gonkumaa hin jenne.
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.prompt: Sarara cuunfaa dhumaa (waa'ee nyaata hin hambisne) deebisii barreessi akka wanta gabaasni jedhu qofa jedhuuf (hiriyaa keetiif dubbii hiriyummaa ta'uu danda'a).
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.hint.0: Himicha gabaasaa sarara kana itti dhufe argi, eenyu fi meeqa akka maqaa kennu sirriitti hubadhu.
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.hint.1: Sarara sana garee fi lakkoofsa sana qofa fayyadamuun deebisii barreessi.
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Sararri koo garee gabaasni gaafate maqaa kennaa?
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Lakkoofsa akka gabaasni kenne eegeeraa, 'baayyee' ykn 'hundaa' hin goonne?

n-k-k6-01.title: Lakkoofsa mana kitaabaa dubbisuu
n-k-k6-01.topic: Dubbii fi ragaa madaaluu: gabateen lakkoofsaa maal agarsiisuu danda'a
n-k-k6-01.goal: Gabatee lakkoofsa mana kitaabaa xiqqaa keessaa himoonni dhugumatti deeggaraman kamtu akka ta'e murteessi, garaagarummaa mata-duree poostarii fi gabatee gidduu jiru argi, fi lakkoofsaan ibsi.
n-k-k6-01.material:
Mana kitaabaa naannoo tokko gabatee fi poostarii maxxansse.

[우리 동네 도서관 3월 이용 현황]
구분 | 작년 3월 | 올해 3월
이용자 수 | 2,400명 | 3,000명
빌려 간 책 | 5,200권 | 5,100권
(올해 3월부터 1층에 무료 공부방을 열었습니다.)

[포스터]
"도서관 덕분에 우리 동네 사람들이 책을 더 많이 읽게 되었습니다!"
n-k-k6-01.thinking.0: Wanta gabateen lakkaa'u fi wanta dubbiin jedhu adda baasuu
n-k-k6-01.thinking.1: Hima deeggaramee fi hima abdachiisaa adda baasuu
n-k-k6-01.thinking.2: Lakkoofsa akka ragaa ibsa keessatti fayyadamuu
n-k-k6-01.prereq.0: Lakkoofsa 명 fi 권 waliin dubbisuu ni danda'a
n-k-k6-01.prereq.1: 늘다 / 줄다 fi 작년 / 올해 ni beeka
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.prompt: Himoota gabateen mataan isaa tilmaama malee deeggaru kamtu? Hunda isaan simatan filadhu.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hima tokko tokkoo 'lakkoofsa agarsiisuu dandeessu' moo 'wanta tilmaamuu qabdu' jedhii mallatteessi.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.hint.1: Waa'ee lakkoofsaa himoota irraa, lakkoofsota lama argi fi kallattii sirrii tiin wal-bira qabi.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.a: Kitaaba jaallachuun miira dha; gabateen daawwannaa fi kitaaba liqeeffame lakkaa'a, miira miti.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.c: 5,200 fi 5,100 irra deebi'ii wal-bira qabi: baay'inni kitaaba liqeeffame karaa faallaa deeme.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.d: Gabateen kutaan qo'annoo bilisaa yaada cinaa qofa tarreessa; kutaan sun sababa ol ba'iinsaa akka ta'e hin agarsiisu.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.explain: Gabateen 2,400 irraa 3,000 daawwattoota (baay'ee) fi 5,200 irraa 5,100 kitaabota liqeeffaman (xiqqoo gadi) agarsiisa. Miira fi sababni gabatee keessa hin jiru, fi 'kitaaba baay'ee' wanta gabateen agarsiisu faallaa dha.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.prompt: Garaagarummaan ijoo mata-duree poostarii fi gabatee gidduu jiru maali?
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.hint.0: Gocha mata-duree poostarii jala sararaa fi sarara gabatee wanta wal-fakkaataa safaru argi.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.hint.1: Wanta sarara gabatee tokko tokkoo lakkaa'u fi wanta mata-dureen namoonni godhan jedhu wal-bira qabi.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.a: Poostarii waa'ee bara darbe dubbata, garuu gabateen bara kana qofa agarsiisa.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.r.a: Gabateen golee bara darbe fi bara kana lamaanuu qaba.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.b: Poostarii namoonni caalaatti dubbisan jedha, garuu gabateen daawwattoota xiqqaa agarsiisa.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.r.b: Gabateen daawwattoota baay'ee agarsiisa, xiqqaa miti.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.c: Poostarii sirrii dha, sababni mana kitaabaa hojii baay'ee qabu dubbisuu dabalu.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.r.c: Daawwattoota baay'ee dubbisuu caalaa dha: namoonni sababa biraatiin dhufuu danda'u, fi lakkoofsi liqaa hin guddanne.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.d: Poostarii waa'ee dubbisuu dubbata, garuu gabateen daawwannaa fi liqaa lakkaa'a, fi liqaan hin ol ba'ne.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.explain: 'Caalaatti dubbisuu' wanta gabateen lakkaa'u miti. Safartuun isa dhiyoo kitaaba liqeeffame, fi hin ol ba'ne. Daawwattoonni baay'inni kutaa qo'annoo haaraa irraa ta'uu danda'a, garuu gabateen jechuu hin danda'u.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.prompt: Hima 1-2 (Afaan Ingilizii ykn Koriyaa) gabateen mata-duree poostarii deeggaruu moo hin deeggarre fi maaliif jedhi. Xiqqaan lakkoofsa gabatee keessaa tokko fayyadami.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sarara gabatee 'dubbisuu' tti dhiyoo ta'e maqaa moggaasi, fi lakkoofsota isaa lama kenni.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ergasii sarara sun waa'ee mata-duree poostarii maal akka hin agarsiifne jedhi.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Gabateen maal akka safaru fi poostarii maal akka jedhu jedheeraa?
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Lakkoofsi koo bakka ragaa ta'ee hojjetu keessa jiraa, garagalchaa qofa miti?
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.model.0: Gabateen daawwattoota baay'ee agarsiisa (2,400 irraa 3,000), garuu kitaabonni liqeeffaman 5,200 irraa 5,100 tti gadi bu'e, kanaaf namoonni caalaatti dubbisan hin agarsiisu.

n-k-k6-03.title: Kuuponiin murteessuuf gahaadhaa?
n-k-k6-03.topic: Gahumsa odeeffannoo: wanta kuuponiin jedhu fi wanta banaa dhiisu
n-k-k6-03.goal: Wanta kuuponiin duraanuu deebisu fi wanta banaa dhiisu adda baasi, ergasii hiriyaa deebisi qabxii tokko sirreessuu fi isa banaa gaafachuun.
n-k-k6-03.material:
Har'a Wiixata, 4월 27일 dha. Hiriyaan kee 민아 ergaa fi kuupoonii siif erga.

민아: 나 카페 쿠폰 받았어! 이번 주 목요일 수업 끝나고 세 시쯤 학교 앞 모아카페에 가자. 아메리카노 두 잔 시키면 쿠폰으로 4,000원 할인받을 수 있어!

[아메리카노 2,000원 할인 쿠폰]
- 유효 기간: 4월 30일까지
- 사용 매장: 모아카페 전 지점
- 1회 사용 (쿠폰 한 장당)
- 다른 할인과 중복 불가
- 그 밖의 조건은 앱에서 확인하세요.
n-k-k6-03.thinking.1: Dhugaa tokko amma illee hanqate argachuu
n-k-k6-03.prereq.0: Guyyaa fi guyyoota torbanii ni beeka
n-k-k6-03.prereq.1: Beeksisa gabaabaa 해요체 dubbisuu ni danda'a
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.prompt: Yoo karoora 민아 hordofte kuuponii tokko Americano lamaaf Kamisa fayyadamte, ibsi kam dhugaa dha?
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.hint.0: Filannoo hundaa sararoota kuuponii maxxanfaman wajjin qori: kan mirkaneessuu dandeessu fi kan faallessu kam?
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.hint.1: Wanta kuuponiin jedhu qofa fayyadamuun karoorri kuuponii wajjin fi malee gatii meeqa akka ta'u herregi.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.a: Kuuponiin hanga Kamisaatti darbeera, kanaaf hir'inni hin jiru.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.a: Kamisni April 30 dha, '4월 30일까지' immoo guyyaa sana of keessaa qaba.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.b: Kuuponiin dhugaatii tokkoo irraa won 2,000 hir'isa, kanaaf waliigala 4,000.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.b: '1회 사용' kuuponii tokkoon altokko jechuu dha, dhugaatii tokkoon altokko miti.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.c: Hir'ina biraa dabaluun kuusaa won 2,000 caalaa guddisa.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.c: '다른 할인과 중복 불가' hir'inni wajjin makamuu hin danda'u jechuu dha.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.d: Kuuponiin tokko altokko won 2,000 hir'isa, 4,000 miti.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.explain: Har'a Wiixata 27 dha, kanaaf Kamisni 30 dha, guyyaa dhumaa fayyadu. Kuuponiin altokko fayyada, hir'ina biraa wajjin hin makamu, kanaaf dhugaatii lamaaf illee waliigala won 2,000 qofa hir'isa.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.prompt: Karoorri Kamisa waaree booda naannoo 3:00 kaafee mana barumsaa fuuldura jiru keessatti. Gaaffiin kam kuuponiin hin deebisne, garuu ammallee karoora dhaabuu danda'a?
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.hint.0: Gaaffii hundaaf sarara kuuponii isa deebisu barbaadi; kanneen deebisuu dandeessu irra sarari.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kutaan karoorichaa kam sarara maxxanfame tokkoon illee hin haguugamne?
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.a: Kuuponiin guyyaa dhumaa fayyadu ammuma kenneera, Kamisnis isa wajjin simata.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.b: Kuuponiin kuuponii tokkoon altokko fayyada jedhee ammuma jira.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.d: Kuuponiin damee 모아카페 hundatti hojjeta jedhee ammuma jira.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.explain: Guyyaan, lakkoofsi fayyadamaa fi dameewwan kuuponii irratti maxxanfamaniiru. Sarara dhumaa 'haalota biroo' banaa dhiisa, yeroon guyyaa immoo daawwannaa 3:00 waaree booda tiif barbaachisuu danda'a.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.prompt: 민아 tiif Afaan Koreaatiin deebisi (해요체 hiriyummaa). Yaada won 4,000 jedhu tasgabbiin sirreessi, gaaffii banaa mirkaneessuuf gaafadhu ykn yaada kenni.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kutaa gabaabaa lama barreessi: kuuponii irraa wanta beekte, ergasii wanta beekuu barbaadu.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.hint.1: Xumura yaada kennu ykn gaafatu fayyadami, fakkeenyaaf '-(으)ㄹ까요?'.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kuuponiin dhugumatti maal akka kennu (hir'ina won 2,000 tokko) jedheeraa?
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Gaaffiin koo waa'ee wanta kuuponiin hin jenne tokko dha?
